item.title: Scott City opening FEMA shelter ahead of severe weather

item.title: Condemned building collapses in downtown Zeigler after strong winds
item.description: ZEIGLER, Ill. (KBSI) — A condemned building collapsed late Sunday morning in Zeigler after strong winds blew out parts of the structure, according to the Zeigler Fire Department. item.title: Kentucky airman among six killed in U.S. tanker aircraft crash
item.description: WASHINGTON (KBSI)— Six U.S. Air Force crew members were killed when a KC-135 Stratotanker crashed during operations in Iraq earlier this week, according to military officials. The aircraft went down March 12 during Operation Epic Fury, and search and recovery efforts concluded the following day.
